snippet.title: Maximum Football - 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Maximum Football 1.0 comes to Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and for the first time ever on PlayStation 5 on June 17th. The community-driven, free-to-play football sim is exiting early access and releasing to 1.0 later this month. 

Follow Maximum Football on X: https://twitter.com/maxfootballgame
Follow Maximum Football on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/maxfootballgame/
Join the Maximum Football Discord: discord.gg/S8yg7EG2gA
